title: Rigorous Asymptotic Analysis of 3-Noncrossing Skeleton Diagrams
summary: We give a complete rigorous asymptotic analysis of the generating functions of 3-noncrossing skeleton matchings and canonical 3-noncrossing skeleton diagrams. Let $F_3$ be the ordinary generating function of 3-noncrossing matchings, and let $S(y)=\sum_{n\geq 0}S(n)y^n$ be determined by $S(zF_3(z)^2)=F_3(z)$. The proof is deliberately ordered to avoid circularity. First, Lagrange inversion, a Stieltjes representation of $F_3$, exact cut-boundary estimates, and a moving horizontal Hankel contour give $S(n)\sim 24(πA^5)^{-1}σ^{-n}n^{-5}$ independently of any $Δ$-analyticity of $S$.
